_help: Pick a voice for each character in ElevenLabs (Voice Library, or Voice Design using the description), copy its Voice ID, and paste it into voice_id. Mimic lines reuse the same voice with unstable settings; the game adds the rest of the wrongness.

voss.description: Elderly man in his 70s. Gravelly, tired, slow small-town American. Has seen terrible things and doesn't talk about them.

leo.description: Boy around 9 years old. Soft, sweet, a little shy. If you can't find a child voice, pick the youngest, softest voice available; the game can raise its pitch slightly.

mom.description: Woman in her 50s. Exhausted, tearful, loving.

anchor.description: Male local TV news anchor, 50s, 1990s broadcast style. Measured and professional.

marco.description: Young man in his 20s. Friendly pizza driver, slightly nervous, New Jersey / Italian-American flavor.

kids.description: A child's voice (any). The game layers it three times so it sounds like children speaking in unison.

ana.description: Woman in her late 20s. Warm, sarcastic, slightly husky. Sam's best friend.

officer.description: Man in his 40s. Deep, calm, flat, authoritative police voice.

tom.description: Young man in his 20s. Goofy, cheerful, a bit drunk.

eli.description: Man in his 40s. Breathless, panicked, in pain.

dad.description: Man in his 50s. Rough, gravelly, emotional, a little drunk. A broken father.

hale.description: Elderly woman in her 80s. Sweet, sing-song grandmother voice that makes your skin crawl.
